concerns.text: T021 implements the null distribution generation but fails to explicitly mandate the independent permutation of the MWQ outcome vector for each of the N iterations. FR-005 and SC-002 require a true null distribution generated by shuffling the outcome variable. The task description 'N=200 permuted MWQ score vectors' is ambiguous and risks implementing a fixed-shuffle loop or a single shuffle repeated 200 times, which would fail to satisfy the statistical requirement of FR-005.

T030 requires calculating partial correlation using 'residuals from the Ridge Regression model' but does not explicitly specify that this model must be the full model including motion confounds (FD, DVARS) as mandated by FR-003. If the task implementation uses a reduced model or an unadjusted model to generate residuals, the resulting partial correlation will not satisfy SC-005's requirement to measure independence 'after controlling for mean framewise displacement'.

T021b introduces a 'Dynamic N' clause allowing runtime-based reduction of the null distribution sample size. This violates FR-005's requirement for a fixed, reproducible procedure and Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility). The statistical power of the p-value would vary based on CI load, making the result non-reproducible and potentially inflating Type I error rates.

T034b requires generating a `criteria_status` object with narrative summaries for SC-001 to SC-005 but omits the requirement to include the actual computed empirical values (e.g., specific p-value, correlation coefficient) in the JSON. Without these values, the `final_report.json` cannot serve as the 'Single Source of Truth' (Constitution Principle IV) required to verify that the success criteria were actually met.
